note: License map for Simplfy stats plates. Lesson text is original teaching notes. Definitional authority: NIST e-Handbook (U.S. public domain) and original Simplfy language, then Wikipedia CC BY-SA as glossary. Companion repos used only where their license permits (Mixtape GitHub, MIT). Named graduate textbooks are citation-only further reading and were not ingested.

preferred_sources.name: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods
preferred_sources.use: Definitional authority for estimation, least squares, experimental design, sample size, residual analysis.

preferred_sources.name: Online Statistics Education (OnlineStatBook)
preferred_sources.use: Sampling, power, and probability hygiene. Worked TB-lab examples are original.

preferred_sources.name: Introduction to Modern Statistics, 2nd edition (Diez, Çetinkaya-Rundel, Barr)
preferred_sources.use: Sparse probability/sampling facts only. Plates are original Simplfy notes and are not publisher-branded derivatives.

preferred_sources.name: Wikipedia glossary pages
preferred_sources.use: Short definitional background. Exposition, likelihoods, figures, and checks are original.

preferred_sources.name: Causal Inference: The Mixtape companion GitHub
preferred_sources.use: Potential-outcome and DAG literacy restated in original language. Book prose not ingested.
